Home always overwrites this field after the subscription and its local configuration or script. A switch sets the value, including false; it does not disable injection. Saving changes the candidate and requires a restart to affect an active session.

Off preserves the composed source field. On applies this YAML list: Append unique keeps source items first and adds new items once; Override replaces the entire list. An empty override clears the source. Restore defaults changes only this draft’s content. Saving requires valid YAML and does not restart the proxy.

On by default with 114.114.114.114 and 223.5.5.5, using Append unique. Off preserves the composed source field. Append unique keeps source items first and adds new items once; Override replaces the whole list. At least one resolver is required. Restore defaults changes only this draft’s content.

Enter the list contents without a dns or nameserver wrapper. Put one item per line, for example:
- 223.5.5.5
- https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query
[223.5.5.5, https://doh.pub/dns-query] is also accepted. Write URL slashes as /, not \/. Adding a preset validates both the existing draft and the combined result, keeping each item once.

Off preserves the composed source. On with Append unique merges by key: the entire Home value for a duplicate key wins, including any list value. Override replaces the whole mapping; an empty override clears it. Restore defaults changes only this draft’s content.

Enter domain-to-resolver mappings without dns or the current field name as a wrapper. Each value is a string or a string list, for example:
"geosite:cn":
 - https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query
"+.example.invalid": [223.5.5.5, https://doh.pub/dns-query]
Quote domains starting with *. Blank input or {} means an empty mapping. Duplicate keys, nested objects and YAML anchors are not accepted.

The desktop default has 18 DIRECT rules. Home prepends this YAML list to the final rules, removing exact duplicates while keeping other source rules in order. Only DIRECT rules are accepted. An empty list adds no prefix. This field has no injection switch or replace strategy.

Enter a rule list without a rules wrapper, for example:
- DOMAIN-SUFFIX,lan,DIRECT
- IP-CIDR,192.168.0.0/16,DIRECT,no-resolve
- IP-CIDR6,fc00::/7,DIRECT,no-resolve
IP rules require no-resolve. Blank input or [] adds no rules. MATCH and proxy targets are not accepted.
Exclude IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR subnets from the Android VPN routes. Off preserves source exclusions; on applies the selected merge strategy.

Use this when a subnet must bypass the VPN entirely. This differs from a DIRECT rule, which still handles the connection inside mihomo. The desktop default is off, with an empty list and Append unique.

Android owns the VPN interface and routes. Android 13+ supports excluded routes; Android 8–12 uses equivalent included CIDRs with a limit of 2,048 routes. Oversized plans fail before VPN establishment. The private DNS address 172.19.0.2 always stays reachable through the VPN. Changes require a restart; desktop auto-route and auto-detect-interface switches do not apply.

Enter a CIDR list, for example:
- 192.168.0.0/16
- fc00::/7
Omit tun and route-exclude-address wrappers. URLs, bare IPs and IPv4-mapped IPv6 are not accepted. Blank input or [] means an empty list.

Enter a YAML resolver list without a dns or proxy-server-nameserver wrapper, for example:
- 223.5.5.5
- https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query
Block lists, flow lists and comments are supported. URL slashes need no escaping. Blank input or [] means an empty list. Adding a preset validates and deduplicates; failures keep the original draft. Off preserves the source; on uses Append unique or Override. Restart an active session after saving.

Enter a YAML domain-pattern list without a dns or fake-ip-filter wrapper, for example:
- +.lan
- "*.example.invalid"
Quote patterns starting with * and text that could be read as a boolean or number. Comments and flow lists are supported; blank input or [] means an empty list. Off preserves the source; on uses Append unique or Override. Restore defaults changes only the draft content.

Enter a YAML domain-to-IP or alias mapping without a hosts wrapper, for example:
example.invalid: 192.0.2.1
ipv6.example.invalid: [192.0.2.2, "2001:db8::2"]
Each value is a string or a non-empty string list; blank input or {} means an empty mapping. Duplicate keys, nested objects and YAML anchors are invalid. Enabling also injects dns.use-hosts=true. Append unique replaces matching keys; Override replaces the whole mapping. Off preserves the source; Restore defaults changes only the draft content.

Enter a decimal integer from 1 to 65535, such as 7890, without a field name, quotes or URL. When DNS is enabled, its listen port must differ from the proxy port. Restart an active session after saving.

Enter IP:port directly, such as 127.0.0.1:1053; use [::1]:1053 for IPv6. Omit dns.listen, quotes and protocol prefixes. Ports must be 1–65535 and differ from the proxy port when DNS is enabled. Restart an active session after saving.
Enter one IPv4 CIDR, such as 198.18.0.1/16, without a field name, quotes or a list marker. Use / directly. Bare IPs, URLs and IPv6 CIDRs are invalid. Restart an active session after saving.

Enter one IPv6 CIDR, such as fdfe:dcba:9876::1/64, without a field name, quotes, brackets or a list marker. Use / directly. Bare IPs, URLs and IPv4 CIDRs are invalid. Restart an active session after saving.
